"Down the face of a precipice, sheer and almost smooth it seemed in the palemoonlight, a small black shape was moving with its thin limbs splayed out.Maybe its soft clinging hands and toes were used, but it looked as if it wasjust creeping down on sticky pads, like some large prowling thing ofinsect-kind. And it was coming down head first, as if it was smelling itsway. Now and again it lifted its head slowly, turning it right back on itslong skinny neck, and the hobbits caught a glimpse of two small pale gleaminglights, its eyes that blinked at the moon for a moment and then were quicklylidded again."
